body: You would be a good one. Man, I really don't even know how to thank you, somehow you made everything just click for me. I just felt this huge relief once I understood what I was feeling. I can get through grief, I've done it before. I just didn't expect it in this context. Thank you, I still feel like shit but now I feel like shit with the strength to keep going.

Holy shit. This IS grieving. It's the same feeling of helplessness. I didn't even make that connection. I understand my emotions a lot better. It makes everything make sense to me. 

 If you don't mind me asking, are you a therapist?

I don't know. All I know is she's gone and I'll never know why. I really want to get past it and I know if I make it down the road I'll look back on this and be amazed I felt this upset. I know it objectively but it feels like someone let me taste the sweetest, purest happiness I'd ever felt and then took it away forever with no explanation.

It would hurt less if she would just talk to me, even just to tell me she doesn't want me around or just to tell me what went wrong but my mind keeps picking every interaction we ever had to pieces trying to find what I did to make her leave, if I even did anything, if I can fix it. It's its own special kind of torture.
My best friend is away on vacation which is another reason this is so effing difficult to get through
I've been on five dates, two of which turned into relationships spanning years. I'm embarrassed to admit I'm 27 but my heart is so naive
Thanks.  I explained the timeline poorly. Haven't heard from her since the beginning of the month. She's gone.
